newsitem.title: USA: NorAm Energy wins 4 Colombia concessions.
newsitem.headline: NorAm Energy wins 4 Colombia concessions.

text.p: NorAm Energy Corp said Friday it received permission to build and operate natural gas distribution facilities at four Colombian concessions.
The company said it expected to start building the distribution systems before October. It said it projects connecting 400,000 customers over five-year period.

NorAm will exploit the concessions with Colombian partners, including coffee growers, local gas distribution companies from other states and regional public works organizations. NorAm's ownership in each concession ranges from 15 percent to 33 percent, the company said.
